thread:
Maya Patel: Heads-up: we need a compact plan for onboarding 'Gaia-Large-v2' with hardware partner Meridian and SI CloudPath. Key unknowns: 1) permitted distribution (quantized bundles vs raw checkpoints), 2) marketplace packaging limits, 3) co-announcement timing. Can we quick-decide owners?
Eli Turner: I can own marketplace packaging. Quick note: Azure marketplace caps single artifact size; best to keep core bundle <5GB and surface larger kernels via authenticated partner download.
Aria Singh: Meridian requires a signed provenance manifest and will only accept q4_8 or q8_0 artifacts on their appliances. They explicitly prohibit installing raw checkpoints. They'll need a kernel compatibility list.
Samir Patel: Runtime side: we can produce q4_8 and q8_0 builds with a runtime shim that disables telemetry by default. We can also embed a signed manifest containing build_id, sha256, and hw_compat hashes.
Sasha (Legal): Licensing position: default = partner may distribute integrated, quantized runtime artifacts only. Any request to redistribute raw checkpoints triggers exception workflow: export control check, indemnity, and exec approval. I'll draft short addendum language for marketplace and partner agreements.
Eli Turner: Marketplace SKU suggestion: GAIA-LG-V2-REDWOOD-EDGE-1.0; short blurb: "Quantized Gaia-Large-v2 packaged with Redwood runtime; signed provenance; partner-optimized kernels via authenticated download." Will map per-cloud requirements and post by EOD.
Aria Singh: For Meridian: provide manifest schema with kernels[] and hw_matrix[] fields. Prefer partner-hosted kernel bundles behind a signed URL rather than bloating the marketplace artifact.
Samir Patel: I'll add automated manifest signer to the build pipeline and create two artifacts: gaia-q4_8-market.tar.gz (no-telemetry) and gaia-q4_8-sandbox.tar.gz (dev telemetry). Will post links when available.
Maya Patel: Timeline: legal addendum by 2024-05-20, marketplace gating mapped by 2024-05-22, Meridian delivery spec by 2024-05-18, runtime bundles by 2024-05-24. PR target 2024-06-12 — marketing needs final copy and logo approvals by 2024-06-03.
Sasha (Legal): Adding telemetry clause: "Partner must not alter manifest or re-enable telemetry without Redwood's written consent." Also adding an export-control checkbox for marketplace forms.
deploy-bot: queued build gaia-q4_8-market-20240518.
Maya Patel: Great. I'll consolidate tasks in the launch doc and set a 05-23 sync. Thanks all.
